_readme: A conversation is nodes with a 'next', or a node with 'choices'. A node that continues nowhere ends the talk. 'set_flag' is collected by the runner and applied by the caller once the line has actually been shown.

greet.speaker: Elder
greet.text: You have the look of someone who builds things and then walks away from them.

promised.speaker: Elder
promised.text: Then the town is yours to fill. Start with the smith - she has been waiting.

deferred.speaker: Elder
deferred.text: Tomorrow is a fine place to keep things.
